name: Startupxplore

sources.title: Startupxplore — CNMV-authorized Spanish equity-crowdfunding platform ('participatory financing platform authorized by CNMV, Registration No. 18'); 'LOOKING FOR FUNDING?' → /en/startups-funding; register/login for investors

conditions: Not a directory — this is a regulated equity-crowdfunding platform; 'submitting' means applying to raise an investment round through them, which is a fundraising process with fees, not a listing
requirements: A fundable high-growth startup, primarily European/Spanish
Regulated process — CNMV authorization (Spain) means KYC/company documentation, an investment committee filter, and campaign terms
Fundraising through the platform involves platform fees on successful rounds
preparation: Fundraising-ready materials: metrics trends (they 'invest in lines, not dots'), deck, financials
Legal readiness for a public equity campaign in Spain
workflow: Run a public syndicate/round on the platform if selected
watchFor: Wrong tool for launch PR — this is for raising a priced round, not listing a product
Geographic tilt: Spanish/European companies and investors
A failed or unfinished campaign is visible — don't apply casually
countsAsLive: The startup has a live fundraising campaign on Startupxplore
unknowns: Platform fee schedule for successful raises
